rules.name: Spitfire Armaments Table
rules.description:
Base
----	2x 20mm Cannons [Hispano Mk.II]

Roll
1	No bombs
2-6	2x Small Bombs [MC Mk.I 250lb]

rules.name: Typhoon Armaments Table
rules.description:
Base
----	4x 20mm Cannons [Hispano Mk.II]

Roll
1	2x Large Bombs [MC Mk.I 1000lb]
2-3	4x Medium Bombs [MC Mk.III 500lb]
4-6	8x 60lbs Rockets [RP-3 SAP/HE]

rules.name: Aircraft Table
rules.description:
1	Supermarine Spitfire
2-6	Hawker Typhoon

You may always choose an aircraft from lower on the table than your roll.  You must still roll for armament.

rules.name: 4+ Comms Test [Corps Battery]
rules.description:
1	2x 25 pdr Field Guns
2-3	2x 4.5-inch Field Guns
4-5	2x 5.5-inch Field Guns
6	2x 155mm/L45 M1 Long Toms

rules.name: 5+ Comms Test [Army Battery]
rules.description:
1	2x 155mm/L45 M1 Long Toms
2-3	2x 7.2-inch Howitzer
4-5	2x 8-inch Guns
6	2x 240mm/L35 Howitzers

rules.name: Bren Carrier Team
rules.description: The Rifle Team in a Bren Carrier Section has a single Bren gun- this is the same weapon mounted in the carrier.  When the Rifle Team disembarks, they take the Bren with them- the carrier no longer has a weapon and can't fire.

rules.name: Bren Carrier Team
rules.description: The Rifle Team in a Bren Carrier Section has a single Bren gun- this is the same weapon mounted in the carrier.  When the Rifle Team disembarks, they take the Bren with them- the carrier no longer has a weapon and can't fire.

rules.name: Vickers HMG Mount
rules.description: Heavy MG Teams on board a Bren Carrier are able to mount their Vickers HMG onto the vehicle, and fire it as a Vehicle MG - Pintle.  When they disembark, they take the HMG with them; the Bren Carrier loses this weapon, but retains its Hull LMG.  If the Heavy MG Team reboards, they may remount the Vickers.
